notes: The installer's lis/addi pair feeding stw ..., 0x27C selects the model table.
Models are the authored basic-shot cohort; tables are deduplicated by address.
The pair record copies actor+0x27C to +0x2C.
Indices are the action-step byte (record+4) copied to pair+0x11.
The source switch handles modes 0..5; other values take the default actor+0x11C vector.
